name: Douwa Shoukougun
source:
Douwa Shoukougun contains two stories that turn fairy tales into erotic stories for adults: "Little Red Riding Hood's Night Tale" and "The Rabbit Girl and the Turtle".

 "Little Red Riding Hood's Night Tale" is the story of Little Red Riding Hood running an errand. As a wolf, I use my skillful words to uncover Little Red Riding Hood's hidden sexual desires. And Little Red Riding Hood blossoms into a lustful adult woman. 

The second episode of the same DVD, "The Bunny Girl and the Turtle", is a sex competition between a turtle man and a lustful bunny girl. The first one to cum loses. The two use all their techniques to attack each other's weak points.
